scope: One exact V2SD Flash with readback, then per-boot 50k5s/100k5s/150k30s trials; conditional fresh-SC recovery. Admission only, not successful execution.
mandatory_conditions: One exact program/verify then complete independent readback before Reset/Run
New successful MCU Reset/Run and actual new user USB-replug reply BEFORE EACH session; no inherited reply
No START since fresh boot; strict discovery7/global256 and fresh mode nonce/selected ACK/CAPS/build before sole START
All prior gates PASS before proceeding; stop remaining sessions on any failure
No SWD/halt during active owner; PASS owners_closed or FAIL cleanup_finished plus closed phase before any diagnostic reads
Two equal frozen136 at0x20002BE4 with current build/nonce/generation; flags0 and observed timing limits; no stale-record override
Normal END0 and matching STOP_ACK, preserved wire/raw/Fresh Open/companion and stopped TIM3/ADC/DMA/clocks/reset gates
Retain SD after throughput failure if boot/communication/stopped confirmed; no automatic retry/rate switch/rollback
Concrete recovery reason only, then fresh SC64KiB verify/readback/reset/new user replug and no-START SC100k READY
Generated helper facts need actual operator chronology and user replies; code constants are not physical evidence

methods: Read exact plan/task/helpers and saved inventory/backup log
Read exact nm symbol and independent backup prefix

ratings.basis: Exact image and negotiated modes/criteria match accepted contract.
Fresh full backup, owner-close gates, per-session boot, fail-stop and conditional recovery.
Exact pins and helper review; future measurements remain unavailable rather than invented.
Bounded single plan without repeated software suites or implementation changes.
Pinned argv, archives, new diagnostic address and recovery instructions.

limitations: PA0 empty tests transport/storage, not voltages or analogue bandwidth
Unknown produced tail is not zero loss
16MiB audit cap depends on actual read fragmentation
Record duration is not full DWT wall interval; no WCET/clock calibration
